senses.en_definition: Attention; the act of focusing one's gaze or mind on someone or something.
Interest or concern shown towards someone or something, including the response or treatment they receive.

messages.en: When did the teacher say the exercises were due again? I couldn't concentrate. I was so sleepy.
Tomorrow morning. Were you up late again last night?
Yeah, I was watching a drama series till two in the morning. I've got to go to bed early tonight.
Have a look at that date at the bottom. It doesn't look right.
Oh, you're right. I've checked, and the year's wrong. I'll fix it now.

senses.en_definition: Personal or private; relating to an individual's own life, opinions, or affairs.
A person considered as an individual; one's own self.
Character or personality; the established qualities, attitudes, and behaviour that distinguish an individual.

messages.en: Don't send it yet. Your personal information is still visible at the bottom.
Oh, I didn't notice. Let me remove my phone number and address first.
Okay, send it to me once you've removed them, yeah? Let's check it again before you post it in the group.

senses.en_definition: To check or inspect something carefully to assess its condition or verify that it is correct.
To examine or test someone or something to determine their condition or learn more about them.
To investigate or scrutinise something to establish the facts.

messages.en: That front tyre looks a bit soft. Have you checked it yet?
Not yet. Hang on, let me check the tyre pressure first.
If it's low, let's stop at a petrol station and put some air in it before we head off.
